newsitem.title: UK: UK shares unnerved by Wall Street, UK rate worries.
newsitem.headline: UK shares unnerved by Wall Street, UK rate worries.

text.p: UK shares ended mostly lower on Monday after a session dominated by an unsteady performance in New York and caution ahead of monetary policy meetings both here and in the U.S. later in the week.
The leading FTSE 100 index finished just off the day's worst levels, down 18.0 points at 4,257.8. Mid-250 stocks lost 20.5 points to at 4,574.9 and volume was a relatively subdued 610 million shares.
Investors found plenty of excuses to stay on the sidelines today, initially prompted by the Dow's late decline on Friday which turned a 43 point gain into an 11 point closing loss.
